Definition: that, used as relative conjunction, and especially (with a preposition) in adverbial phrases; also as preposition of
BiblicalUsage: part of relation; 1) who, which, that; mark of genitive; 2) that of, which belongs to, that; conj; 3) that, because
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
